items.title_cn: Google says it fixed more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, thanks to AI
items.title_en: Google says it fixed more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, thanks to AI
items.summary_cn: As experts have warned for the last two years, some companies — like Microsoft and now Google — are finding and patching an exponential number of bugs in their products, thanks to the use of LLMs and AI tools.

items.title_en: LinkedIn adds a button to report AI-generated ‘slop’
